info.name: Oracle GoldenGate for Big Data REST Artifacts Data Targets API
Oracle Goldengate List Available Data Target Types

items.docs: Returns the list of available big data target types including Kafka, HDFS, HBase, Cassandra, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Kinesis, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and OCI Object Storage.

info.name: Oracle Goldengate Retrieve Json Schema for a Data Target Type

items.docs: Returns the JSON schema describing the configuration for a specific data target type handler.
